en-GB.promotionalText: Apple Intelligence reads your pantry and writes recipes for your exact ingredients. On-device. Instant. Private. No food data ever leaves your iPhone.
en-GB.description:
APPLE INTELLIGENCE COOKS FOR YOU.

Freshli's Rescue Chef is built on Apple's iOS 26 Foundation Models Framework — the same on-device LLM that powers Apple Intelligence. It reads your exact pantry and writes recipes that use what you have. Right now. With no internet. With nothing leaving your phone.

THIS IS NOT CHATGPT FOR FOOD.
No OpenAI. No Anthropic. No third-party cloud. No tokens shipped to a server. The model runs on your iPhone's Neural Engine — instantly, privately, even on aeroplane mode. Your food data is yours. Forever.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Freshli's pantry — it already knows what you have, when it expires, and what's most urgent.
2. Tap Rescue Chef.
3. Apple Intelligence reads the pantry, ranks ingredients by expiry urgency, and writes 3 recipes in 0.8 seconds.
4. Each recipe is grounded in your actual stock — no missing ingredients, no inventions.

GAZE-ADAPTIVE RECIPES
Hold your gaze on a recipe card for 0.6 seconds. Freshli detects your intent (via TrueDepth, on-device) and the card blooms — refraction density deepens, specular highlights track your device tilt, a luminous rim traces the edge. The app responds before you tap.

LIQUID GLASS UI
Every surface in Freshli is rendered live by a Metal 4 refractive shader. Your pantry breathes. Your cards float. Ambient light bends through the interface. No static backgrounds. No flat UI. A living kitchen.

THE MELT TRANSITION
Switch tabs and the current view dissolves through a Metal 4 noise field — pixels liquefying along an organic frontier edged in green light. Your iPhone vibrates in sync: a soft rumble dissolving into a crystalline click as the new screen solidifies.

BUILT FOR 2026
• Metal 4 · MSL 3.2 · Ray-traced specular lighting
• iOS 26 Foundation Models Framework
• 120Hz ProMotion · locked frame budget
• Swift 6 Strict Concurrency throughout
• Full WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility · Reduce Motion supported

SIRI & SHORTCUTS
'Hey Siri, rescue my pantry.'
Siri opens Freshli, runs Rescue Chef, and reads back the top recipe. Hands-free, eyes-free.

WIDGETS, COMPLICATIONS, LIVE ACTIVITIES
• Lock Screen widget — what's expiring today
• Apple Watch complication — quick log
• Live Activities — cooking timer with progress on Dynamic Island
• Interactive widget — one-tap consume

FOR THE FUTURE OF COOKING. RIGHT NOW.

ja.promotionalText: Apple Intelligenceがあなたのパントリーを読み、正確な食材でレシピを生成。オンデバイス、瞬時、プライベート。クラウドへの送信ゼロ。
ja.description:
Apple Intelligenceがあなたのために料理する。

FreshliのRescue Chefは、iOS 26のFoundation Models Frameworkで構築 — Apple Intelligenceを動かす同じオンデバイスLLM。あなたのパントリーを読み、今あるもので作れるレシピを生成。インターネット不要、クラウドへの送信ゼロ。

これは食べ物用ChatGPTではありません。
OpenAIなし。Anthropicなし。サードパーティクラウドなし。送信トークンゼロ。モデルはiPhoneのNeural Engineで動作 — 瞬時、プライベート、機内モードでも動作。

仕組み
1. パントリーを開く — 何があるか、何が期限切れ間近かを既に把握。
2. Rescue Chefをタップ。
3. Apple Intelligenceが緊急度で優先順位付けし、0.8秒で3つのレシピを生成。
4. 各レシピは実在の在庫を使用 — 架空の食材なし。

視線適応レシピ
カードを0.6秒見つめる — オンデバイスTrueDepthが意図を検出。

Liquid Glass UI
Metal 4屈折シェーダーで全表面をライブレンダリング。

料理の未来へ。今すぐ。
